title: Deploy to Production
description: A compact release checklist. Pause points between pre-flight, release, and post-release.

items.text: Confirm release ticket is in Ready state
Verify CI is green on the target commit
Post #releases announcement with commit SHA and rollback plan
Run smoke tests against staging build
Tag the release and push the tag
Deploy to 5% canary and watch error rate for 10 minutes
Verify key user journeys on prod (login, checkout)
Close release ticket and link the tag
Update the status page if user-visible changes shipped
